room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye/yr
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; room rent and ICU also sub-limited

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most conditions); 36 months for joint replacement & osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; limit per pre-hospitalisation event

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of SI (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, etc.)

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure-A List I

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, cosmetic surgery, obesity surgery (conditional)
